label: Bible Study
prompt: So then _____ cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
verse: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
note: Why preaching matters — faith arrives through the ear.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Let the sea _____, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
verse: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
note: Even the sea gets a part in David's praise song: let the sea roar.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then the angel of the LORD put forth the end of the _____ that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the LORD departed out of his sight.
verse: Then the angel of the LORD put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the LORD departed out of his sight.
note: The angel touched Gideon's offering with the tip of his staff, and fire leapt from the rock to consume it.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the _____ of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
verse: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
note: Peter's answer to the Pentecost crowd's 'What shall we do?' — about three thousand responded that day.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent _____ me, and I did eat.
verse: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
note: The first passing of the buck: Adam blamed the woman, and the woman blamed the serpent that 'beguiled' her.
